title: Where football clubs come from: from Sheffield in 1857 to every corner of the world
excerpt: I put 45,931 football clubs from Wikidata on one animated map, in the order they were founded: from Sheffield FC in 1857 to 222 countries and territories, with the oldest club in each and the clubs that folded.
seo_description: An animated map of football clubs by founding year, from Sheffield FC in 1857 to today: first clubs in every country, waves of founding and clubs that died.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where football clubs come from' in black, green and claret on cream, beside a world map with countries shaded by the year of their first football club and dots for clubs coloured from dark red (1857) to purple (2026). Text: 45,931 clubs in Wikidata, from Sheffield FC in 1857 to 222 countries and territories.
